observations: Readiness-check document reload returns HTTP200 and same introduction; browser history Back returns Labs and Forward restores introduction, without stale question content.

Fresh Back screenshot and repeat-Tab screenshot reproduce cookie banner covering Back label and all but the top sliver of its gold outline. Matching PNG SHA256 across request2 and both request3 Back captures strengthens repeatability.
Shift+Tab returns to clearly outlined help summary, then Tab returns to hidden Back label. This refutes a complete focus trap but preserves the visibility defect.
Enter activates Back again, with returned introduction H1 active.
No page errors, route errors, unexpected network failure, origin escape or successful mutation observed. Expected analytics POST blocked once in each context.

finding.impact: A keyboard user can reach and activate Back, but cannot read its label or see a useful complete focus indicator while the cookie banner is present.
finding.scope: Anonymous visitor, cookie choice unset, default desktop theme, CSS viewport1280x800
finding.caveat: Full-page capture positions fixed/sticky elements at the current scroll position; this is a rendered observation, not an independent viewport-only screenshot or WCAG certification.
finding.proposal: Reserve bottom space for the cookie banner and ensure focused controls scroll into the unobscured viewport. Preserve help-summary and introduction-heading focus restoration.
finding.not_executed: No source modification or deployed fix; inputs immutable and public-site changes unauthorized.
